info.name: RetroFlow API
info.description:
Manual and runner tests for the RetroFlow API. Start the app first: ./mvnw spring-boot:run

Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner works): later requests reuse teamId and retroId captured by earlier ones. Each run creates a team with a unique name, so it can be re-run.

Not covered yet: feedback items and changing a real action item, because there is no endpoint to add feedback or action items (O3 in decisions.md).

exec: // Team names are unique (D10): a fresh name per run keeps the collection re-runnable
pm.test("Location header points to the team", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.include("/api/teams/" + team.id));
pm.test("members are returned in order", () => pm.expect(team.members).to.eql(["Alice", "Bob"]));
